name: External Rates And Tenors 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external rates and tenors code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

EURI.name: Euribor
EURI.definition: Euro interbank offered rate (3 months, 6 months and other tenors).

ESOI.name: Euro Overnight Index Swap
ESOI.definition: Euro Overnight Index Swap (ESTROIS) 1 day, 1 week, other tenors.

GBPO.name: GBP Libor
GBPO.definition: Pound sterling London inter-bank offered rate (3 months, 6 months, other tenors) and the respective successor rate.

SOFR.name: Secured Overnight Financing Rate
SOFR.definition: Secured overnight financing rate (1 months, 3 months, other tenors).

USOI.name: USD Overnight Index Swap
USOI.definition: US dollar overnight index swap (1 day, 1 week, other tenors), USDOIS.

USPO.name: USD Libor
USPO.definition: US dollar London inter-bank offered rate (3 months, 6 months, other tenors) and the respective successor rate.
